statement: A principal without principal bindings, a credential with a role cap, is granted nothing by what is bound to it by name: no ALLOW of a Principal binding of the platform or the tenant, or of an attached policy, reaches it. Their DENYs still apply to it, as to its principal: a cap removes ALLOW candidates only, so it never lifts a restriction of the principal (RC1-1). Anyone bindings and its roles still apply.
